reports.title: Post Holdings Reports Results for the Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year 2026

guidance.heading: Outlook
section: Post management expects Adjusted EBITDA for fiscal year 2027 to be between $1,450-$1,500 million. Post management expects fiscal year 2027 capital expenditures to range between $360-$400 million, which includes continued Foodservice investment in cage-free egg facility expansion and Post Consumer Brands investment in nut butter manufacturing optimization.
